original_clock_and_retry_rules: Anchor from earliest actual positive canonical OPEN_UNPROTECTED/OPEN_PROTECTED projection with complete matching entry execution binding, not PENDING_ENTRY or latest partial-fill observation. Verify its opened_at against min original-entry actual canonical fills. Preserve original first-fill average/reference and original approved levels. Then restore_exit_anchor against current actual positive position+same original plan.

Current E5 now comes from service.clock immediately before actual interpretation after source checks; explicit action_expires_at is supplied as an existing engineering management input and validated UTC/future. No invented health/balance/size/TTL defaults. Old entry plan expiry does not revoke existing management; original parent plan/risk binding still must match actual owner policy.

Before fresh native requirements/E2 interpretation/close preparation/action expiry gates, load prior exact authorized exit decision and its actual operation. If CLAIMED/READBACK_REQUIRED, obtain normal current MANAGE_EXISTING via service.reconcile(original_operation_id) directly. Never reinterpret/rebuild old action, translate old request, renew clocks/IDs or POST again.

PREPARED but unclaimed original close requires still-current ORIGINAL local preparation through require_close_preparation+translator.require; missing/cold successor preparation fails closed. Saved exit decision with no durable request may first translate unchanged unexpired original action under genuine current mechanical proofs and exact current original source; changed source/action expiry blocks, never silently reauthorizes same ID.

Stable close ID derives existing stable_position_action_client_order_id(action_id,POSITION_EXIT) then stable_order_request_id; prepare_close_order sets request.created_at=now, so original durable request must never be retranslated on retry. Existing single-close claim inventory plus final guard must remain active before POST.

HOLD/BLOCKED with no action cannot dispatch. Current fixture has trailing=None; first join may retain one immutable anchor plus first authorized decision. If later extending monotonic trailing observation persistence, use existing exit_state snapshot semantics; NON_EXECUTABLE_PROFILE remains non-executable and grants no MODIFY_PROTECTION. No inference that active standing stop has triggered/disappeared from price or flatness.
